evidence.claim: The BB construction is represented by two bivariate polynomials whose monomials define connectivity among X-check, Z-check, left-data, and right-data qubits.
Algorithm 1 identifies a set of novel coprime BB codes; Table 1 reports their lattice parameters, defining polynomials, [[n,k,d]] parameters, and kd^2/n scores.

The paper highlights a [[54,8,6]] code and notes that previously proposed [[108,16,6]] and [[162,24,6]] codes have exactly two and three times its n and k values, leaving the structural relationship as future work.
